definitionZh: 滤波器 CSS 属性将模糊或色移等图形效果应用到元素上. 过滤器通常用于调整图像的渲染,背景,和边框.
sourceDefinition: The filter CSS property applies graphical effects like blur or color shift to an element. Filters are commonly used to adjust the rendering of images, backgrounds, and borders.
